video_script: STOP! Look at your hands right now. What if I told you… they're secretly GLOWING? Sounds crazy, right? But scientists discovered that your entire body is constantly giving off tiny amounts of light! It's caused by chemical reactions happening inside your cells. And here's the wild part… the light is roughly ONE THOUSAND times too weak for your eyes to see! Scientists used an ultra-sensitive camera to capture this invisible glow. And discovered something even stranger… its brightness changes throughout the day! So technically, you're a walking light show… with the brightness turned WAY down! Would you want to see your own glow? Comment below!
